item_name: Rothco U.S. Flag Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Elevate your patriotic style with Rothco's U.S. Flag Low Profile Cap. Featuring an embroidered U.S. flag on the center, it's a bold statement of your pride. Crafted from comfortable yet durable brushed cotton twill, this cap ensures long-lasting wear. The adjustable hook and loop closure make it suitable for most head sizes, offering a personalized fit. An internal sweatband is built in for added comfort, keeping you cool and dry during wear. With a buckram front panel, this cap maintains its structured shape for a polished look.
